# Public-repo workflow load guard (plan 2026-11-01 public-repo-actions-migration §3a step 5, card t_a4fdb8ba).
# Ruling: Apollo 2026-11-02 14:30 (ruling:t_a4fdb8ba-archive-perm-loadguard-set-gbrain-home).
#
# GitHub disabled Actions on ANG-Ventures/hermes-agent for run volume (1,906 runs on 10-05). On the public
# repo only the correctness + security floor runs. Every workflow file with a trigger of its own (anything but
# `workflow_call`) is classified here; scripts/ci/public_workflow_allowlist_lint.py fails a PR that adds one
# without a line, and `--live` fails when GitHub's state for the repo below disagrees with this file.
#
# Line forms:
#   live: <file>                 stays active on the public repo (pull_request + push:main)
#   callee: <file>  # <why>      has its own trigger but a live workflow calls it; stays active, reason required
#   disabled: <file>             kept `disabled_manually` on the public repo until re-enabled with a reason
# Files whose only trigger is `workflow_call` need no line (they cannot start a run on their own).
# Re-enabling a workflow = move its line to `live:` in a reviewed PR, then `--live --apply`.

repo: ANG-Repositories/hermes-agent

live: ci.yaml
live: lint.yml
live: js-tests.yml

live: contributor-check.yml
live: history-check.yml
live: fleet-secret-scan.yml
live: fleet-sast.yml
live: cancel-superseded-pr-ci.yml

callee: windows-install-update-e2e.yml  # ci.yaml -> tests-os.yml calls it; own push trigger is wine2e-install/** only
